name: shoppilot-ai-monorepo
description: ShopPilot AI - Autonomous grocery restocking agent for PayPal AI hackathon

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
